name: Points, arcs and a swing turn
description: Six mclib motions that are not paths, on a four-motor base: drive to a point, turn to face a point, a quarter circle, a swing turn on one side of the drive, a quarter circle backward, and backing up to a point. In the simulator the two point steps end 0.3 and 0.5 in off and the turns 0.6° and 2.1° off. The arcs end 2.3 in and about 2° off: an arc stops when the robot faces the heading, so its end position is wherever the circle took it. 12.2 s.

steps.note: face a point to the right
a quarter circle to the right
turn on one side of the drive
back up around a quarter circle
